style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, warm daylight
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window, props go in subordinate clauses. HIS BODY crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too. His legs stay in shot, no prop between his body and the lens, never facing the lens while talking. No window ends on an impact, a grip or a planted pose; a moving prop or a camera move alone never counts; new shot size every window
character: a stocky brown beaver, orange chisel teeth, flat scaly tail, wet fur, grave
props: COUPON: one large sheet of stiff cream paper with one printed percent sign, no other marking. BOX: a squat crate of split logs with a heavy hinged lid and an iron ring. BOULDER: a wet grey rock
prop_continuity: one coupon, the same sheet from first window to last, flat and clean until it bursts; he grips it by the edge in his teeth off to one side, body clear of it, shoves the box along the logs, never holds either at his chest, never stands behind it
environment: outdoors on a beaver dam of logs, a wide river behind, open sky
lighting: bright midday sun, water sparkling, high exposure

audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 3.5 syllables/sec, never drawn out
audio.pacing: speech 0.6-2.4 and 5.4-8.6; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable
audio.sfx: river rush; wooden lid banging at 2.9; boulder thudding at 4.7; one heavy trap snap at 8.7 and paper bursting

timeline.a: silent. He explodes up out of the river onto the dam and lands running the whole frame, the coupon in his teeth off to one side, spray flying
he runs left to right past the lens in profile along the logs, his body edge to edge, the coupon streaming back from his teeth
he wheels round and drives the log crate along the dam ahead of him with his shoulder, his body sweeping the frame bottom to top
silent. He slams the coupon flat into the crate, kicks the lid down and hammers it with his tail, walking the crate across the frame as he beats it
silent. He shoves the crate off the dam and dives the width of the frame after it into the river, hauling it back up the logs and butting the lid open on the run: the coupon lies flat and clean
silent. He rolls the wet boulder the width of the dam and drops it on the shut crate, then tears the lid open in one lunge: the same coupon is still flat and clean
he leaps clean over the crate and runs the length of the dam past the lens, the crate skidding after him
he swings on the iron ring and hauls the crate up onto the highest log, his whole body climbing the frame bottom to top
he throws the lid up and dives head first at the open crate, his body crossing the frame edge to edge, one paw out for the paper
silent. He rips his paw out of the snapping lid and rolls the width of the frame, that same coupon bursting into a cloud of shreds behind him
silent. He dives the width of the frame through the falling shreds, sweeping them along, the empty crate rolling past his legs

must_appear: one and the same coupon all the way through, the coupon flat and clean after the river and the boulder, the lid snapping shut like a trap, that same coupon bursting into a cloud of shreds
negative_prompt: speech bubble, caption box, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, digits, a second coupon appearing, a torn coupon before 8.6, night, dark scene, slow motion, a head-on medium shot, a prop covering his body, a static wide at the end, any voice outside the speech windows, drawn-out delivery
